description.value: JINYA Ramen Bar is a Japanese ramen chain with a Vancouver Downtown location on Robson Street, one of the city's main retail and dining corridors. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating in an air-conditioned space, with wheelchair accessibility. As a sit-down ramen restaurant, it would provide a warm, restorative meal for cyclists passing through central Vancouver.
